title: Strict increase of padded length
statement: For all $C,c\in\mathbb{N}$, the function $n\mapsto n+(C+1)(n+1)^c$ on $\mathbb{N}$ is strictly increasing.
replaced:
For all $C, c \in \mathbb{N}$, the map $\mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ given by
$n \mapsto n + (C+1)(n+1)^c$ is strictly increasing (also when $c = 0$).
